text: My brother texted me right after the match and said he's never seen a comeback that dramatic. He was practically shouting through the phone.
She just switched phones and says the new camera is noticeably better in low light. Her review video was actually pretty helpful.

He finally beat the final boss after twenty attempts and immediately posted his reaction in the Discord. His hands were shaking the whole time apparently, and honestly the whole server lost it with him.
My girlfriend says she's done waiting around for people who don't text back. Honestly, her patience is way stronger than mine, I'd have snapped by now.
Our new manager, David, keeps taking credit for other people's work in every single meeting. He did it again today in front of the whole team and it's getting exhausting to watch, not gonna lie.

Finally caught up on the finale last night. Emily's character arc this season felt rushed compared to how carefully they built her up before. She deserved a better ending honestly, and the writers really dropped the ball this time imo.
The council member, Robert, promised better bike lanes downtown and then quietly voted against the funding. He never even explained why. Typical.
Talked to a rep named Jessica about my refund and she kept talking over me like I was the problem. She was useless honestly and just wasted twenty minutes of my time.

Watched the game with Kevin last night and he would not stop complaining about the ref calls the entire second half. He was being a total idiot about it, honestly, and I could barely enjoy the game myself.

My teammate tonight, Rachel, was so bad she should honestly just uninstall the game. She missed every single callout and then got mad at everyone else, and it made the whole match miserable, absolute trash performance.
